title: Electrum wallet data
whyItMatters: Electrum keeps wallet files holding keys and transaction history. Losing them can make the coins unrecoverable without the seed phrase.
source: Electrum documentation, FAQ "Where is my wallet file located?": the data directory on macOS is ~/.electrum (wallets in ~/.electrum/wallets)
notes: Earlier draft used ~/Library/Application Support/Electrum, which is not where Electrum keeps wallets.

cleanup.exportFirst: Write the seed phrase of each Electrum wallet down on paper from the wallet menu and store it somewhere safe.
steps: Confirm you have the recovery phrase or backup for every wallet in the folder.
Quit Electrum so its files are not in use.
Delete the Electrum folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Wallet files and transaction history on this Mac are gone. Without the seed phrase the coins cannot be recovered.
